label: readersIgnored: the fake's readers table ignored, so every dropped file is refused
find: public func readers(ofExtension ext: String) -> [String] { Self.readerTable[ext] ?? [] }

label: placesNothing: the fake places no type, so a dropped PNG opens instead of landing as a rect
placeNotAStep: the placed rects aren't recorded, so undo can't take the drop back
fillSkipsLock: setFill finds the selected rect without the locked check, so a locked rect takes a fill
replace: guard let index = rects.firstIndex(where: { $0.id == selection }) else { return }

label: nilFillEncoded: a rect with no fill writes "fill":null, so old JSON changes
fillUndoKeyDropped: every stop-move sample is its own step, so a drag takes many undos
